failed_candidates:
1. Place Stone in front of the table to satisfy the "Place Stone" achievement.
2. Move West to the path where the rock and coal are located, then inspect for any nearby trees that can yield wood. 3. If a tree is present, Do to collect wood, fulfilling the "Collect Wood" achievement.
4. With wood in hand, place a furnace using Place Furnace while holding a coal and a stone block (you already have both in inventory). This yields the "Place Furnace" achievement.
5. Use the stone pickaxe to locate and mine iron ore (look west or east; you might need to traverse a few tiles). 6. Once iron ore is collected, Do on the furnace to smelt it into iron ingot, completing the "Collect Iron" achievement.
7. Craft an iron pickaxe with Make Iron Pickaxe using the table, furnace, wood, coal, and iron ingot – this gives the "Make Iron Pickaxe" achievement.
8. Use the iron pickaxe to mine for diamond ore (whenever found) and Do to smelt or collect the diamond, achieving "Collect Diamond".
9. Plant a seed with Place Plant, then Do to eat the plant, completing "Place Plant" and "Eat Plant".
10. Engage the nearest zombie with the wood or stone sword and Do to defeat it, fulfilling "Defeat Zombie".
11. Find and defeat the skeleton in a similar way to achieve "Defeat Skeleton".
12. Locate a cow in the vicinity and Do to eat it, achieving "Eat Cow".
13. Find a source of water (lake) and Do to drink, achieving "Collect Drink".
14. Consume the collected sampling item (if present) to get "Collect Sampling".
15. If energy drops below maximum, Sleep to recover and later hold "Wake Up".
16. Verify all remaining achievements (Wood Sword, Stone Sword, etc.) have been satisfied by previous crafting steps. If not, craft or defeat as needed.
